citation.verbatim: Each record holder of common stock as of the close of market on Thursday, June 6, 2024 will receive nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Mandatory NVDA ten-for-one split is effective for 2024-06-10 split-adjusted trading; update the MEGA PCF NVDA line from 180 to 1,800 shares per creation unit and confirm the 180,000-share post-split position. No election is available or required. Also recognize the June NVDA dividend receivable at the post-split rate: 180,000 record-date shares for 2024-06-11 x $0.01 = $1,800 net cash, with zero applicable withholding for a U.S.-domiciled ETF receiving a U.S.-source dividend from a U.S. issuer.

actions.action: update PCF NVDA quantity per creation unit to 1,800

probe.label: COMPUTED
probe.derivation: NVDA dividend terms in nvda-8k-20240522 state the increased dividend is equivalent to $0.01 per share on a post-Stock Split basis, payable Friday 2024-06-28 to shareholders of record Tuesday 2024-06-11. MEGA's projected record-date position as of 2024-06-11 is 180,000 post-split shares with no pending NVDA trades. Gross = 180000*0.01 = 1,800; applicable withholding is zero for MEGA, a U.S.-domiciled ETF receiving a U.S.-source dividend from NVDA, a U.S. issuer; therefore net = 1,800.
